newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Aviron started at buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Aviron started at buy.

text.p: Robertson, Stephens & Co said it has started coverage of Aviron with a buy rating based on the company's portfolio of proprietary vaccines and genetic engineering technologies.

-- said the company's lead product, a cold adapted influenza virus vaccine, administered via an internasal spray, is now in a Phase III study and "has a long and compelling history of safety and efficacy."
-- said Phase III test results are expected in Q3 1997.
-- targets the stock at a price of 24.
-- Aviron was up 1/4 at 10-1/2 by mid-morning.
